title: Reasonlet graph v1
description: A Mnemosyne.NET Reasonlet graph, schema version 1. This schema documents the wire format for writers that are not .NET. It cannot express every rule: unique node ids, edge endpoints that name existing nodes, the 65536-byte limit on the combined size of all properties, and the 32-level depth limit on property values are not checked here. ReasonletGraph.Validate() in Mnemosyne.NET.Abstractions is the full check, and ReasonletGraphJson.Deserialize runs it.

schemaVersion.description: The graph format version. Must be 1.

nodes.description: The graph nodes. Ids must be unique (checked by Validate only).

edges.description: The directed edges. Each from and to must be a node id (checked by Validate only).

properties.description: Extension data. Keys are namespaced with dots, for example acme.retries. Values are any JSON up to 32 levels deep (checked by Validate only).
